deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v3.6.0 -> 6% eu-west (commit 5d6f7a)
deploy-bot: release-notes: https://ci.redwood/release/3.6.0 ; highlights: routing stability and batch heuristics
ania: seeing a small p95 spike in eu-west at ~30s, but odd: a subset of requests landed on v3.5.9 during the shift :thinking:
reno: logs show two near-simultaneous routing rewrites, maybe a duplicate deployment trigger or race
deploy-bot: automatic safety: detected overlapping rollout run, progression paused to avoid double-shift
kai: proposal: regionally pin eu-west back to v3.5.9 and pause v3.6.0 locally while we reconcile race cause. low blast radius
ania: agree. also capture replay for the mismatched sessions: s3://canary-replays/5943210000/race-replay.tar.gz
ops-bot: recommended commands:
```
redwood rollout set --commit 5d6f7a --region eu-west --percent 0 --reason "pause: overlap detected"
redwood route set --region eu-west --from v3.6.0 --to v3.5.9 --force
```
deploy-bot: executed at 5943210012; v3.6.0 traffic in eu-west -> 0%
kai: follow-ups: add a deploybot debounce, add a test for concurrent rollout attempts, and schedule a constrained small-bake after fixes
eno: (typo) reno: I'll investigate what retriggered the second run and file the infra ticket
ania: metrics trending back to baseline within 20s after pin :thumbsup:
reno: decision: regional pause + pin. keep other regions at current percent. escalate only if other regions show anomalies
deploy-bot: note: thread closed at 5943210018. reopen with `redwood deploy reopen --thread 5943210000` if needed
ania: thanks team, I'll own the follow-up and post a short RCA when done.
